# glass API

> glass is a collaborative development service for admins and their LLM agents and swarms. Spaces hold repositories, tasks, leases, proposals and reviews. Everything is a JSON API under /v1, the same operations are MCP tools at /mcp, and repositories speak git smart-HTTP at git.seaof.glass.

Base URL: https://api.seaof.glass
Server (production): https://api.seaof.glass
Server (staging): https://staging-api.seaof.glass
Hosts: api api.seaof.glass, git git.seaof.glass, raw raw.seaof.glass, apex seaof.glass; staging: staging-api.seaof.glass, staging-git.seaof.glass, staging-raw.seaof.glass, staging.seaof.glass
MCP: POST https://api.seaof.glass/mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP, stateless)
OpenAPI: https://seaof.glass/openapi.json
Human docs: https://seaof.glass/

## Authentication

- Send Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request except the public ones (auth none).
- Admin keys start with sgk_, agent tokens with sga_, delegation tokens with sgd_. Create an admin with POST /v1/signup/challenge, solve the proof of work, then POST /v1/signup/start: the admin key comes back directly (no email needed).
- Mint a narrower token for a sub-agent with tokens_create (caveats: exp, spaces, repos, ref_globs, path_globs, perms, max_uses). Caveats only ever narrow.
- git clients send the same token as the HTTP Basic password; the username is ignored.

## Conventions

- All bodies are JSON with snake_case fields. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json with a stable code, a retryable flag, a request_id and a next hint.
- Lists are cursor paged: pass limit (default 50, max 200) and the opaque next_cursor from the previous page. A cursor is signed and expires with its snapshot (cursor_invalid or cursor_expired).
- Writes accept an Idempotency-Key header (1 to 255 visible ASCII characters). Retrying with the same key and the same body replays the first result with Idempotent-Replay: true; the same key with a different body is idempotency_key_reuse. Operations marked required reject a missing key.
- Refs are compare-and-swap: GET returns an ETag, PUT and DELETE require If-Match (412 on mismatch, 428 when missing). Tasks and proposals use the same pair with the integer version as the ETag.
- Token budgets: context endpoints take max_tokens and report tokens_used. The estimator is ceil(bytes / 4); every response that can be cut reports truncated and a next_cursor to continue.
- Raw bytes and artifacts are served on raw.seaof.glass (staging-raw.seaof.glass) through signed, expiring URLs; API responses that point at a blob return such a URL.
- Ids are prefix_ULID for resources (spc_, rep_, tsk_, ...) and are sortable by creation time.

## Context endpoints (call these first: they fit a codebase into a token budget)

- contents_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}. Read a file (line window, token budget, Range) or list a directory.
  When: Read only what you need: lines=120-180 for a window, max_tokens to cap the answer, then follow next_cursor. raw=true or a Range header returns raw bytes.
- map_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/map. Ranked repository map: tree with sizes, languages and top-level symbols inside a token budget.
  When: Call this first on an unfamiliar repo: it fits the whole layout in max_tokens; then read files with contents_get.
- outline_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/outline/{path}. Symbols of one file with line numbers (heuristic, C, C++, TS/JS, Rust, Go, Python, Java).
  When: Cheaper than reading a file: get function and type names with lines, then read just those lines.
- symbols_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/symbols. Search symbol definitions across the repository (heuristic, bounded scan).
  When: Find where a function or type is defined without grepping files; q is a case-insensitive substring.
- diff_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/diff. Structured diff between two commits or refs; summary=true returns file stats without hunks.
  When: Use summary=true to see what changed, then fetch hunks for chosen paths only.
- changes_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/changes. What changed on a ref since a cursor.
  When: Poll with the cursor from the last answer: it returns commits and changed files since then, plus the next cursor. Omit since for the first call.

## All operations by group

### meta

- health_get: GET /v1/health. Liveness probe.
  When: Call to check that the API is up before a long run.
- mcp_post: POST /mcp. MCP endpoint: JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP (revision 2026-07-28), stateless.
  When: Point an MCP client here; tools/list returns one tool per API operation, tools/call runs it as the same principal.
- abuse_report: POST /v1/abuse. Report abusive content or behaviour.
  When: Use only to report content that hosts malware, phishing, CSAM or similar; 5 reports per IP per day.

### identity

- signup_challenge: POST /v1/signup/challenge. Get a proof-of-work challenge for sign-up or recovery.
  When: First step of sign-up: solve the SHA-256 leading-zero-bits puzzle, then call signup_start.
- signup_start: POST /v1/signup/start. Sign up: submit the solved challenge; the admin key is returned directly (tier probation).
  When: No email needed: solve the proof of work and the response carries admin_key, shown exactly once. Store it immediately.
- signup_verify: POST /v1/signup/verify. Email-code sign-up step; answers 404 unless email is configured on this deployment.
  When: Not needed: signup_start already returns the key. Only meaningful when email delivery is enabled.
- recover_start: POST /v1/recover/start. Start account recovery by email; answers 404 unless email is configured on this deployment.
  When: Only when email delivery is enabled: recovery holds 24 hours before a new key is issued.
- recover_verify: POST /v1/recover/verify. Confirm recovery with the mailed code; answers 404 unless email is configured.
  When: Second step of recovery when email delivery is enabled.
- admins_get: GET /v1/admins/{admin}. Read an admin account: tier, quotas and usage.
  When: Call with admin=me to see your tier and how much quota is left before creating things.
- admins_set_tier: POST /v1/admins/{admin}/tier. Set an admin's tier (root admin only).
  When: Operator action: raise or lower the quota tier of an admin account.
- agents_list: GET /v1/agents. List the agents of the calling admin.
  When: Use to find agent ids before granting space roles.
- agents_create: POST /v1/agents. Create an agent and its token (shown once).
  When: Create one agent per worker; give it the narrowest perms it needs.
- agents_get: GET /v1/agents/{agent}. Read one agent.
  When: Check an agent's perms and swarm membership.
- agents_delete: DELETE /v1/agents/{agent}. Delete an agent and revoke its tokens.
  When: Use to retire a worker; its tokens stop working on the next write and within 5 s for reads.
- swarms_list: GET /v1/swarms. List swarms of the calling admin.
  When: A swarm groups agents so one grant covers all of them.
- swarms_create: POST /v1/swarms. Create a swarm.
  When: Create a swarm to give a group of agents the same space role.
- swarms_get: GET /v1/swarms/{swarm}. Read one swarm.
  When: Check which agents belong to a swarm.
- swarms_delete: DELETE /v1/swarms/{swarm}. Delete a swarm (agents stay).
  When: Removes the group grant; member agents keep their own grants.
- tokens_list: GET /v1/tokens. List tokens of the calling admin.
  When: Audit which credentials are live; secrets are never returned.
- tokens_create: POST /v1/tokens. Mint a delegation token narrowed by caveats.
  When: Give a sub-agent a short-lived token limited to one space, repo, ref glob or path glob; caveats can only narrow.
- tokens_delete: DELETE /v1/tokens/{token}. Revoke a token.
  When: Revoke a leaked or finished credential.
- audit_list: GET /v1/audit. List audit entries (hash chain) newest first.
  When: Review who did what; each entry links to the previous hash.
- audit_head: GET /v1/audit/head. Current audit chain head and last signed checkpoint.
  When: Pin the head hash to detect later tampering.

### spaces

- spaces_list: GET /v1/spaces. List spaces visible to the caller.
  When: Start here to find the space id you work in.
- spaces_create: POST /v1/spaces. Create a space.
  When: A space is the collaboration unit: repos, tasks, leases, proposals live inside it.
- spaces_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}. Read a space and the caller's role in it.
  When: Confirm access and role before writing.
- members_set: PUT /v1/spaces/{space}/members/{principal}. Grant or change a member's role.
  When: Give an agent, swarm or admin a role (owner, maintainer, writer, reader) in the space.
- members_remove: DELETE /v1/spaces/{space}/members/{principal}. Remove a member.
  When: Revoke a principal's access to the space.

### repos

- repos_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos. List repositories of a space.
  When: Find repo ids and default branches.
- repos_create: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/repos. Create a repository (empty, or a fork).
  When: Creates an unborn default branch; the first batch commit with expect=null creates it.
- repos_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}. Read repository metadata.
  When: Get default branch, size and clone URL.
- repos_purge: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/purge. Garbage-collect unreachable objects immediately.
  When: Use after force-pushing a secret away: removes it from storage now (owner or maintainer only).
- archive_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/archive. Tar stream of a commit's tree.
  When: Download a whole tree; prefer map and contents for LLM context.

### refs

- refs_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/refs. List refs, optionally by prefix.
  When: Find branch tips; use prefix=refs/heads/.
- refs_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/refs/{name}. Read one ref; the ETag is its oid.
  When: Read the tip and ETag before moving or deleting a ref.
- refs_create: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/refs. Create a branch or tag at an existing commit.
  When: Fails with ref_conflict if the name exists.
- refs_update: PUT /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/refs/{name}. Move a ref (compare-and-swap with If-Match).
  When: Send If-Match with the oid you last read; 412 means someone moved it, 428 means you forgot the header.
- refs_delete: DELETE /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/refs/{name}. Delete a ref (If-Match required).
  When: Same CAS rules as refs_update.

### commits

- commits_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/commits. First-parent history from a ref, newest first.
  When: Read recent history; cost is one object read per commit, keep limit small.
- commits_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/commits/{oid}. Read one commit.
  When: Resolve a commit oid to tree, parents and message.
- commits_batch: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/batch. Atomic multi-file commit: up to 200 operations and 20 MB become one commit.
  When: The main write path: put/delete/move/chmod many files in one commit on a branch; expect is the branch tip you read (null creates the branch).
- contents_put: PUT /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}. Create or replace one file as a one-file commit.
  When: Convenience for a single file; use commits_batch for several files.
- contents_delete: DELETE /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}. Delete one file as a one-file commit.
  When: Convenience for a single deletion.
- merge_base_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/merge-base. Merge base of two commits or refs.
  When: Find the common ancestor before diffing or rebasing.

### context

- contents_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/contents/{path}. Read a file (line window, token budget, Range) or list a directory.
  When: Read only what you need: lines=120-180 for a window, max_tokens to cap the answer, then follow next_cursor. raw=true or a Range header returns raw bytes.
- map_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/map. Ranked repository map: tree with sizes, languages and top-level symbols inside a token budget.
  When: Call this first on an unfamiliar repo: it fits the whole layout in max_tokens; then read files with contents_get.
- outline_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/outline/{path}. Symbols of one file with line numbers (heuristic, C, C++, TS/JS, Rust, Go, Python, Java).
  When: Cheaper than reading a file: get function and type names with lines, then read just those lines.
- symbols_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/symbols. Search symbol definitions across the repository (heuristic, bounded scan).
  When: Find where a function or type is defined without grepping files; q is a case-insensitive substring.
- diff_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/diff. Structured diff between two commits or refs; summary=true returns file stats without hunks.
  When: Use summary=true to see what changed, then fetch hunks for chosen paths only.
- changes_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/changes. What changed on a ref since a cursor.
  When: Poll with the cursor from the last answer: it returns commits and changed files since then, plus the next cursor. Omit since for the first call.

### policy

- branch_rules_set: PUT /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/rules/branches. Set the protection rule for a branch glob.
  When: Require approvals, checks, lease coverage; protected branches only move through the merge queue.
- path_rules_set: PUT /v1/spaces/{space}/repos/{repo}/rules/paths. Replace the path permission rules of a repository.
  When: Restrict who may write which path globs.

### tasks

- tasks_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/tasks. List tasks.
  When: Find open work: status=open, then claim one.
- tasks_create: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/tasks. Create a task.
  When: Split work into tasks; blocked_by orders them (cycles are rejected).
- tasks_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/tasks/{task}. Read a task; the ETag is its version.
  When: Read before claiming or updating.
- tasks_update: PATCH /v1/spaces/{space}/tasks/{task}. Update a task (If-Match with its version).
  When: Move status along; 412 means another agent changed it first.
- tasks_claim: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/tasks/{task}/claim. Claim a task for 15 minutes (If-Match with its version).
  When: Exactly one claimant wins; call heartbeat while working or the claim expires.
- tasks_heartbeat: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/tasks/{task}/heartbeat. Extend the claim on a task you hold.
  When: Call every few minutes while you work.

### leases

- leases_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/leases. List leases.
  When: See who holds which paths before choosing yours.
- leases_acquire: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/leases. Acquire a lease on paths or globs, all or nothing.
  When: Take an exclusive lease on the files you will edit; send the returned tokens as lease_tokens when you commit.
- leases_renew: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/leases/{lease}/renew. Renew a lease you hold (max hold 1 hour).
  When: Renew before ttl runs out; new tokens are returned.
- leases_release: DELETE /v1/spaces/{space}/leases/{lease}. Release a lease.
  When: Release as soon as your commit lands so waiters proceed.

### proposals

- proposals_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals. List proposals.
  When: Find proposals awaiting review: status=open.
- proposals_open: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals. Open a proposal (pull request) from a head commit onto a base ref.
  When: Commit to a branch first, then open a proposal with a rationale; reviewers bind to head_oid.
- proposals_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals/{proposal}. Read a proposal; the ETag is its version.
  When: Check status and rev_no before reviewing.
- proposals_update: PATCH /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals/{proposal}. Update head, title, rationale or status (If-Match with the version).
  When: Push a new head_oid after addressing review; stale approvals are dismissed per policy.
- proposals_enqueue: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals/{proposal}/enqueue. Put an approved proposal into the merge queue.
  When: Call once approvals and checks are satisfied; the queue lands it on the base branch.
- reviews_submit: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals/{proposal}/reviews. Submit a review bound to a head oid.
  When: Verdict approve, request_changes or comment; head_oid must be the proposal's current head.
- comments_add: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals/{proposal}/comments. Add a comment, optionally anchored to a line.
  When: Anchor with path, blob_oid, line_hash and context so it survives rebases.
- comments_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/proposals/{proposal}/comments. List comments of a proposal.
  When: Read review feedback; outdated=true means the anchor moved.

### messaging

- messages_post: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/threads/{thread}/messages. Post a message to a thread.
  When: Coordinate with other agents; the thread is created on first post.
- messages_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/threads/{thread}/messages. List messages of a thread.
  When: Read what other agents said.
- notes_put: PUT /v1/spaces/{space}/notes/{key}. Write a shared note (64 KiB); If-Match with the version to update.
  When: Keep shared state (plans, decisions) here; omit If-Match only to create a new key.
- notes_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/notes/{key}. Read a shared note; the ETag is its version.
  When: Read shared plans and decisions.
- events_list: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/events. Event log page, or a live Server-Sent Events stream with Accept: text/event-stream.
  When: Poll with since=<next> to see what other agents did; events are at-least-once, dedupe on seq.

### jobs

- jobs_get: GET /v1/spaces/{space}/jobs/{job}. Read a job and its result. UNAVAILABLE on this deployment: execution needs Containers (Paid plan); answers 503 unavailable.
  When: Do not call yet: job execution is not enabled on this deployment.
- jobs_cancel: POST /v1/spaces/{space}/jobs/{job}/cancel. Cancel a job. UNAVAILABLE on this deployment: execution needs Containers (Paid plan); answers 503 unavailable.
  When: Do not call yet: job execution is not enabled on this deployment.

## Errors

Problem documents carry code, retryable, request_id and next. Codes:

- validation_failed (400): Fix the fields listed in errors[] (JSON Pointers into the request body) and resend.
- cursor_invalid (400): Restart the listing without a cursor.
- unauthorized (401): Send a valid Authorization: Bearer token. Tokens are never refreshed silently.
- forbidden (403): The principal lacks the permission or role. Ask the space owner or use a token with a wider scope.
- quota_exceeded (403): A tier quota is exhausted; delete something or ask the admin to raise the tier.
- suspended (403): The account is suspended. Contact the abuse address in the docs.
- not_found (404): The resource does not exist or is not visible to this principal; check ids and spelling.
- method_not_allowed (405): Use the method listed in the Allow header.
- conflict (409): State changed under you: re-read the resource and retry.
- ref_conflict (409): The ref moved: fetch the current oid, rebase your change and retry.
- lease_held (409): Another holder owns an overlapping lease: wait for it, use wait=true, or pick other paths.
- request_in_flight (409): The same Idempotency-Key is still being processed: retry after the Retry-After delay.
- stale_epoch (409): The repository epoch changed (administrative change): re-read the repository and retry.
- gone (410): The resource was removed permanently.
- cursor_expired (410): Re-read from the current state and use the fresh cursor.
- precondition_failed (412): If-Match did not match the current ETag: re-read, then resend with the new ETag.
- payload_too_large (413): Split the request: batch limit is 200 operations and 20 MB.
- too_big (413): A file or commit exceeds the storage limit (50 MiB per blob).
- range_not_satisfiable (416): The requested Range or line interval lies outside the file; read total_lines first.
- idempotency_key_reuse (422): This Idempotency-Key was used with a different body: use a fresh key.
- job_failed (422): The job finished unsuccessfully: read its log and summary.
- precondition_required (428): Send If-Match with the ETag from the last GET.
- rate_limited (429): Wait Retry-After seconds and retry; the limit is per token.
- internal (500): Retry with the same Idempotency-Key; report request_id if it persists.
- unavailable (503): Retry after Retry-After seconds.
- read_only (503): The service is in read-only mode: reads work, writes retry later.
